slides.title: Beacon Hollow Works — Trade Start Logic Model

columns.heading: WHAT WE PUT IN
items: A fitted-out joinery workshop on the Beacon Hollow industrial estate
Four qualified tradespeople release one day a week to teach

columns.heading: WHAT WE DO
items: A sixteen-week introductory joinery course for school leavers
Employer site visits arranged in week twelve of every cohort

columns.heading: WHAT WE MAKE
items: Four cohorts of twelve school leavers trained every year
Forty-eight employer site visits arranged annually

columns.heading: WHAT CHANGES SOON
items: Leavers can set out and cut a mortise and tenon unsupervised
Leavers hold a current site safety card on completion

columns.heading: WHAT CHANGES EVENTUALLY
items: Leavers are still working in the building trades three years on
Beacon Hollow employers fill apprenticeships locally rather than regionally
